# Independent manual workflows

**Bump version** accepts one required `mode`: `patch` (default), `minor`, or
`major`. Select a branch with GitHub's built-in ref selector. The helper validates
the selected immutable commit and remote branch, commits only version-source
tokens, and pushes one direct child. It never tags, builds, publishes, or
dispatches another workflow.

**Build** has no custom inputs and runs only by manual dispatch. Every checkout
uses `github.sha`; canonical source `X.Y.Z` determines the release version.
An existing tag or draft/public release blocks publication. The two workflows
are independent: run Build separately after choosing the desired source ref.

## Authority and intake

The API canonical repository is `miyako/4d-plugin-get-system-colors`; API default,
symbolic `origin/HEAD`, and advertised HEAD agreed on `master` at immutable intake
`3124ea17a95c80bd4572ce6ebd48b24c67a222e9`.
Complete rename-follow Bump history contains the introduction at
`58647a1b14565ae40bf5d1a9d2151f290c622677`. Its explicit header coordinates
MARKETING_VERSION, CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION, and both plist version keys, despite
the implementation mistakenly editing marketing only.

The migration does not increment authoritative `3.1.2`. It aligns only six stale
source CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION tokens (`3.1.0`) and the actually copied
`English.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` short/info display tokens (`3.1.0`). The six
Development/Deployment/Default configuration identities and names are validated.
Info.plist retains `$(MARKETING_VERSION)` and its absent build key stays absent.
The source localization keeps its original CR-only line endings. All prebuilt
bundle bytes, including stale destination localization, remain unchanged.

Version edits preserve original encoding/BOM, individual newline styles, modes,
references, optional build-key absence, and unrelated bytes. All sources validate
before writes; malformed, duplicate, unresolved, cyclic, drifting, or missing
metadata fails closed. Built XML/binary plist and compiled or textual localization
are checked against the selected source.

## Native scope

The original workflow is macOS-only, despite its Windows-build comment.
It still builds target **System Colors**, configuration **Default**, universal
arm64+x86_64, with deployment override **11.0**. No Windows job, dependency build,
runtime policy, toolchain modernization, or new architecture exclusion is added.
The project keeps Cocoa and its existing library/resource configuration.
The custom shell phase's credential/signing/notarization branch runs only for
Deployment and remains unchanged and inactive for Default.

The actual product is `test/Plugins/System Colors.bundle`: the project sets
CONFIGURATION_BUILD_DIR to BUILD_DIR. Cleanup prevalidates all targets before
deleting only exact generated leaves and System Colors intermediate directories.
It never removes whole bundles, Default siblings, QuickLook, custom resources,
the tracked prebuilt Windows64 payload, or libraries. The pre-sign gate requires
nonempty regular nonsymlink unsigned leaves; the final gate additionally requires
the fresh signature. Copied manifest/constants must match source exactly.

Initial preflight rejects all dirty, untracked, and ignored files. Final checks
retain generated bytes, allowing only exact generated leaves, selected product
intermediates, exact `build/XCBuildData/build.db` and WAL/SHM companions, and
32-lowercase-hex `.xcbuilddata` descendants. There is no blanket build/bundle
exemption and no dependency-path exception. HEAD, the entire index, hidden flags,
and raw nongenerated bytes remain protected, including the prebuilt Windows leaf.
Nothing is reset to pretend a built checkout is clean. Windows raw-mode
compatibility applies only to actual win32 regular files with exact hashes;
index mode/blob checks remain exact. Build sets process-scoped
`core.autocrlf=false` before checkout, never global configuration.

Notarization requires both exit zero and strict JSON status Accepted for each
archive, followed by stapling and strict signature verification.
Original empty release body and disabled generated-release-notes policy remain.

## Publication and recovery

`release-publication` is one constant cross-ref concurrency group with
cancellation disabled, not a FIFO guarantee. No default-only restriction is
invented. Explicit nonempty GH_TOKEN, case-sensitive canonical repository
identity, and immutable GITHUB_SHA are required.

Authenticated availability runs before native work and after all native gates.
Every release page, including drafts, is read until an empty page. Exact API
tag refs and the exact remote advertisement must both show absence. Transport,
authentication, 404, malformed JSON/schema, duplicate keys, and nonfinite numbers
abort publication.

Publication creates a tag ref at the selected SHA, verifies API and remote SHA,
creates a new public release with a new positive ID, then uploads exact ZIP/DMG
assets only to that ID. GitHub's space-to-dot asset-name sanitization is checked.
There is no reuse, update, clobber, deletion, rollback, or automatic retry.
On failure, inspect retained tag/release ID/assets reported by the helper; a lost
response may hide a successful request. Reconcile manually before choosing a new
version. Do not blindly rerun.

The executable bump hook must match its committed 100755 raw blob before edits
and immediately before push. It accepts exactly one literal new-SHA/HEAD update
with the selected advertised old SHA, a clean nonempty source-only direct child,
and the literal ending Copilot App co-author trailer. Both no-follow-tags
controls are required. Advanced, rewound, deleted, and same-result races fail.
The separate migration hook permits only this migration branch and exact
advertised old/new values.

## Offline validation

```sh
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml
```

Tests use disposable real Git repositories and closed-PATH native/credential
doubles, not real native tools, credentials, or production mutation APIs.
Set PLUGIN_TEST_SCRATCH to an existing artifact directory for fixtures outside
the checkout. Immutable raw-blob reference pins accompany the regression suite.
These checks establish command/gating contracts, not hosted toolchain/service
success.
